entity.summary: Non-custodial peer-to-peer cryptocurrency marketplace operated under the AgoraDesk and LocalMonero brands. The operator began a voluntary wind-down on May 7, 2024 and disabled creation of new trades on May 14, 2024.
entity.notes: AgoraDesk and LocalMonero were two brand surfaces of the same non-custodial P2P platform and are consolidated as one entity. HEI uses May 14, 2024 as the exchange death date because new trade creation ended then. Account access, dispute support, and fund recovery remained available during the wind-down until the planned November 7, 2024 website closure. No legal domicile, predecessor, or successor is inferred.

events.title: AgoraDesk and LocalMonero disabled new trades
events.description: Following a voluntary wind-down announcement on May 7, AgoraDesk and LocalMonero disabled creation of new trades on May 14, 2024 while retaining temporary account, dispute, support, and fund-recovery access.
events.notes: The later November 7 website-removal deadline is preserved as part of the wind-down schedule but is not used as the exchange death date because trading had already ended.

evidence.title: LocalMonero / AgoraDesk will be winding down its operations
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states that registrations and ad postings stopped immediately, new trades would be disabled on May 14, and support and fund recovery would continue through the November wind-down deadline.

evidence.title: AgoraDesk guides and wind-down notice
evidence.notes: Current first-party page repeats the May 7 start, May 14 end of new trades, and November 7 website-removal schedule.
